Motonari's party barely escaped
their plight and cheated death.
Ouchi Yoshitaka also got away, and
his army was spared the worst.

Amago regain their strength, and
the two great powers, Ouchi and
Amago, were deadlocked once more.


And so the seasons turned. Spring.
